metadata.title: Late 90s R&B Girl Group Album Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel portrait composition featuring soft-focus photography, ethereal tulle textures, and a mix of modern geometric and decorative script typography typical of late 90s R&B.
triggerTerms: sage green and purple color palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite layout featuring a large foreground trio and a smaller three-panel header, unified by a soft sage-green background and ethereal translucent fabric overlays in lavender and blue.
coreVisualRelationships: Hierarchical split between a small-scale top gallery and a large-scale foreground trio
Contrast between the structured geometric main title and the fluid decorative subtitle
Repetition of tulle textures across different subjects to create visual unity
Soft, diffused lighting that minimizes harsh shadows on skin tones
coreInvariants: Translucent fabric (tulle/organza) as a primary prop and texture
Soft-focus photographic finish with low local contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in the foreground at 75% height; three smaller individual portraits in a horizontal row at the top 25%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central geometric title 'divine' positioned at the horizontal center, bridging the top and bottom sections.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top row of portraits, drops to the central title, then flows down to the main trio and the script text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures and fabric textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage green background providing a neutral, cool-toned base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lavender and periwinkle blue tulle providing cool-toned highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep purple for the script typography and dark olive for the dresses.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with mid-range values; no pure blacks or whites.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses lowercase geometric circles for 'd' and 'e' counters
Subtitle uses a fluid, continuous-line script with exaggerated loops
Tight letter spacing in the sans-serif title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'v' and 'i' in the main title are tightly kerned to touch or nearly touch
The 'F' and 'T' in the script have long, sweeping descenders and ascenders

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over background, under top portraits

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, modern geometric sans and a fluid, organic traditional script.
graphicDevices: Outer glows for legibility against busy backgrounds

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric lowercase aesthetic of the main title.
Captures the fluid, informal energy of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a composite image with a sage green background. The top quarter should have three small, separate portraits of women. The bottom three-quarters should feature a trio of women in the foreground, draped in translucent lavender and blue tulle fabric. Use soft, diffused lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large lowercase geometric sans-serif title in the center, bridging the top and bottom sections. Add a decorative, looped script subtitle in purple with a white outer glow at the bottom center, overlapping the foreground subjects.

verificationChecks: Are there two distinct rows of portraits?
Is the main title lowercase and geometric?
Does the subtitle use a looped script with a white glow?

postGenerationChecks: Check for soft-focus consistency across all panels
Ensure the tulle looks translucent and layered
Verify the geometric title is perfectly centered
Confirm the script text is legible against the fabric
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sage-green backdrop with multi-scale portraits, layered with translucent fabric, and topped with a mix of geometric sans and decorative script typography.
